unit_label: BRBL Module B unit 5: Securities and modes of charge I — Select mortgage remedies by the governing provision and conditions rather than assuming universal court-only or immediate private sale

facts.statement: Courseware outlines judicial sale/foreclosure distinctions and a suit process, while making broad court-only enforcement statements; actual non-judicial statutory routes and conditions need separate sources.
facts.locator: S04 printed pp. 189–193; PDF page = printed page + 19

facts.statement: Section 67 provides qualified court sale/foreclosure rights with mortgage-type exclusions. Section 69 permits sale without court only in its defined cases and subject to its conditions. Neither a universal court-only rule nor an unrestricted private-sale right follows merely from a mortgage label.
facts.locator: sections 67 and 69, official Delhi text headings

payload.title: Foreclosure, sale and a personal money claim are different remedies
payload.core_explanation_md:
**Foreclosure** concerns barring the right to redeem; a **sale** seeks sale of the property toward the secured amount. Section 67 qualifies who may seek these remedies, including exclusions for specified mortgage types. An income-based possession arrangement is not interchangeable with every sale-remedy arrangement.

A credit file should identify the mortgage form, the obligations and the provision relied on before presenting a recovery route. A personal repayment covenant and a property remedy also need to be distinguished. Do not infer every remedy from a generic security label or from the fact that a default occurred.

self_check.prompt_text: Why should the recovery note identify the mortgage form before selecting sale or foreclosure?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The statutory remedy rules and exclusions vary with the form and applicable terms.

payload.title: Private sale needs its own authority and conditions
payload.core_explanation_md:
Section 69 contains defined circumstances and conditions for sale without court intervention. Its existence means the courseware's general court-only summary cannot safely be turned into a universal rule. But the section equally does not allow every mortgagee to sell immediately on default.

The bank must establish the applicable case, deed powers where required, place and party qualifications, notices and other conditions. Other recovery statutes may have their own routes and exclusions; they need separate source review. This batch teaches selection of the legal route, not an instruction to enforce a particular security or a certification that any live sale power exists.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a clause labelled power of sale alone prove that every proposed sale can proceed immediately?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The governing statutory case, terms and procedural conditions must be established.

payload.stem_md: A recovery handbook says every mortgage can only ever be enforced through a court sale. Which part of the inspected statutory framework prevents that being stated without qualification?

options.text_md: The general fact that property values change
options.explanation_md: Valuation changes do not establish the existence or absence of a statutory enforcement route.

options.text_md: Section 69 recognises defined non-judicial sale cases subject to conditions
options.explanation_md: Its qualified power defeats the universal statement, while not creating an unrestricted private-sale right.

options.text_md: Any mortgagee may choose to ignore all notice requirements
options.explanation_md: The provision is expressly conditional; it does not allow unilateral disregard of procedure.

options.text_md: Every document called a mortgage is an unconditional sale
options.explanation_md: A mortgage classification does not automatically become an unconditional disposal of ownership.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Its qualified power defeats the universal statement, while not creating an unrestricted private-sale right.

payload.stem_md: A lender sees an English-mortgage label and a power-of-sale clause, then plans immediate private sale without checking party/place qualifications or notices. What should the reviewer require?

options.text_md: Only a new valuation to replace all legal conditions
options.explanation_md: Valuation cannot establish the applicable statutory sale case or compliance with its conditions.

options.text_md: Only proof of default, because that always completes every sale requirement
options.explanation_md: Default alone does not satisfy all Section 69 qualifications and procedure.

options.text_md: An assumption that English mortgages can never have any non-judicial route
options.explanation_md: The statute includes defined cases; a universal denial is as unsupported as a universal permission.

options.text_md: Identification of the governing statutory case and compliance with its deed, party/place and procedural conditions
options.explanation_md: The label and clause cannot substitute for the full authority and conditions analysis.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The label and clause cannot substitute for the full authority and conditions analysis.
